##### Project general facts

Binghatti Hillcrest is a contemporary residential development located in Arjan, featuring the developer’s signature architectural style and a refined approach to modern living. The building is defined by clean lines, geometric elements, and thoughtfully designed layouts that maximize space, light, and functionality. The project offers a selection of studios, as well as one- and two-bedroom apartments, all created to provide a balanced living environment that combines comfort, elegance, and everyday practicality.

Residents benefit from a range of amenities designed to support wellness and an active lifestyle. The development includes a state-of-the-art indoor gym, an adults’ swimming pool, a dedicated children’s pool, and a running track, along with landscaped green areas that create a calm and inviting atmosphere. These features are carefully integrated to encourage relaxation, outdoor activity, and a sense of community within a well-planned residential setting.

Interiors are finished with modern, high-quality materials and enhanced by a smart home system, ensuring both comfort and convenience. Apartments feature equipped kitchens, providing immediate functionality for daily living. Units are offered unfurnished, allowing residents to personalize their interiors while benefiting from well-designed layouts and a contemporary architectural foundation.

##### Location description and benefits

Arjan, situated in the heart of Dubailand, is a rapidly growing community known for its family-friendly environment and excellent connectivity. Developed with sustainability in mind, Arjan features a mix of residential, commercial, and leisure spaces, making it a well-rounded destination for living and recreation. The neighborhood is home to notable landmarks such as the iconic Dubai Miracle Garden, one of the largest floral installations in the world, and the Dubai Butterfly Garden, which houses thousands of exotic butterfly species.

The community offers a mix of modern residential developments with contemporary architecture and thoughtfully designed apartments, often surrounded by lush green landscapes. Arjan places a strong emphasis on outdoor living, with parks, jogging tracks, and landscaped areas providing residents with ample opportunities for relaxation and leisure. Retail outlets, supermarkets, and dining options are conveniently located, ensuring that daily needs are easily met.

Its strategic location provides excellent connectivity to Dubai’s key areas. Arjan is just a short drive from Mall of the Emirates, Dubai Marina, and Al Barsha, with major road networks like Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road ensuring easy access. This combination of tranquility, convenience, and modernity makes Arjan a sought-after destination for residents seeking a balanced urban lifestyle in Dubai.
